description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Magical Blink 1] and [Physical Blink 1], grants [Soul Break Gauge +250], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Gordon], [Hour of Purpose Ability Tracker] and [Hour of Purpose Level] to the user

description.name: Magical Blink 1
description.text: Evades the next non-PHY, non-NIN attack that deals magical, fractional or missing HP damage

description.name: Physical Blink 1
description.text: Evades the next PHY attack that deals physical, missing HP or fixed damage or NAT attack that deals physical or fractional damage

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Gordon
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Hour of Purpose (0~2), removed after using Hour of Purpose two times

description.name: Hour of Purpose Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Hour of Purpose level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Support abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Gordon]

description.name: Hour of Purpose Level
description.text: Keeps track of Hour of Purpose level (0~2), grants [Hour of Purpose SB Cost Reduction] to the user after increeasing Hour of Purpose level to 2, removed if user hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Gordon]
